messages:
Aisha Patel: Hey finance team :wave: I checked out early from Marriott SFO yesterday (had to fly home for a family emergency). Hotel charged the corpcard for 2 nights but they issued a pro-rated voucher for 1 night. Can we get the one-night refund applied back to the corpcard? I uploaded the voucher but the scan is a bit blurry. Folio: 01234567. Charge on card: $528.00. Voucher amount: $264.00. I will create an expense in Expensify (EXP-2140).

Attachment: blurry_scan.jpg

cc @Jonas Kim

Jonas Kim: Thanks Aisha. Can you paste the folio line items or the final folio PDF here? We need the merchant folio number and the exact timestamps to validate with the processor. If the voucher was issued, the hotel should issue an adjustment posting; otherwise we can request a reversal with the acquirer.

Aisha Patel: Pasting folio snippet:
```
Marriott SFO
Folio #: 01234567
Room Charge 06/12 - 06/13 : $264.00
Room Charge 06/13 - 06/14 : $264.00
Total: $528.00
Voucher issued: -$264.00 (voucher #VCH9087)
Final balance charged to card: $264.00
```
Oops the confirmation above says final balance charged $264 but corpcard statement shows $528. Need help reconciling.

Jonas Kim: Hmm OK. Could be that the hotel issued a voucher but didn't reverse the authorization. Can you confirm the transaction date on your corpcard statement and last 4? Also, please forward the voucher email to help@finance.redwood.com. I'll open a dispute if needed. Also include the folio PDF upload to Expensify.

Aisha Patel: Corpcard txn date 2026-06-14, last4 1234. Forwarded voucher email to help@finance.redwood.com and uploaded folio PDF to Expensify. Expense category `TRAVEL:HOTEL`.

FinanceBot: Thanks — we've created ticket FIN-5621. Please note processing time for merchant reversals can be 7-14 business days. If the charge remains after 14 days, Finance will initiate a formal chargeback. Ticket link: https://finance.redwood.com/tickets/FIN-5621

Maya Rodriguez: Approved for pro-rate refund; no issue with policy. Aisha, once Finance confirms reversal, mark the expense as "card refunded" in Expensify so we don't reimburse you. :white_check_mark:

Jonas Kim: I'll follow up with the bank today. If the hotel provides an adjustment posting, please upload it here. If not, I will initiate the dispute and keep you posted. ETA: 2-3 business days.

Aisha Patel: Thanks all — appreciate the quick responses. Will ping if I get any conflicting docs.
